notes.title: Autumn Sale : Goldengrove 🍂
notes.content:
[h2]Unleaving - Autumn Sale & Goldengrove Inspiration[/h2] 

“Margaret, are you grieving  
Over Goldengrove unleaving?”  

The [b]Steam Autumn Sale[/b] is here, bringing with it the golden hues of fall, the fleeting beauty of Goldengrove, and the transient nature of the season. These themes have deeply inspired the world of [b]Unleaving[/b], a game where every frame feels like a painting.  

Now is the perfect time to celebrate the beauty of fall with art, emotion, and 30% off!🍂

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076720/Unleaving/

We’re passionate about [b]Bridging Traditional Painting and Video Games[/b]. Recently, we had the chance to partner with the [b]Hand Eye Society[/b] to discuss how traditional mediums can merge with game development. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2315833941?t=00h33m12s]Check out the talk here[/url]. It’s just one of the many ways we’re constantly exploring new creative possibilities.

notes.title: Unleaving - UPDATE
notes.content:
We're excited to announce an UPDATE for Unleaving, based on your requests and valuable feedback! Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Added Localization in more languages: Now you can enjoy the game in Portuguese-Brazilian, Russian, Italian, and Turkish.
[*] Experience smoother gameplay: We've increased jumping/push responsiveness, specifically tailored for PCs with minimal requirements.
[*] Improved Hinting System: We've made minor adjustments to our hinting system to provide even better guidance.
[*] Optimized Music Volume: Enjoy a seamless audio experience as we've normalized the music volume.
[/list]

Side note: We wanted to remind players that on instance of dying during Unleaving’s gameplay they can press any key to immediately trigger level restart instead of waiting 3 seconds.

Thank you for supporting indie games and being part of Unleaving’s community. As a token of our gratitude, we're providing a 15% discount to our players this week.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Unleaving is out now!
notes.content:
[b][h2]Unleaving is Out Now![/h2][/b]

Hello all,

Just as today, we celebrate the release of Unleaving with you!

We are thrilled to announce the release of Unleaving! It is now available on PC, with the Mac release coming soon. Immerse yourself in a world of living paintings with original traditional art assets and mind-bending puzzles. Experience Unleaving for yourself:
[list]
[*] 3-4 hours of gameplay
[*] Unique art and puzzles with no repetition; every scene features original traditional art assets, described as having Van Gogh vibes
[*] A puzzle platformer reminiscent of Limbo with a splash of color; featuring physics-based and timing puzzles to learn from death
[*] Languages: Available in multiple languages
[/list]
